title: Owl dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#2b1f4d'/>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <rect x='40' y='78' width='5' height='12' rx='2.5' fill='#ffb347' transform='rotate(-18 42.5 84)'/>
  <rect x='55' y='78' width='5' height='12' rx='2.5' fill='#ffb347' transform='rotate(20 57.5 84)'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='91' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#ff8c1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='91' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#ff8c1a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='24' fill='#7a5230'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='13' ry='16' fill='#f4d6a0'/>
  <!-- wings out dancing -->
  <path d='M29 52 Q14 48 10 34 Q22 40 30 44 Z' fill='#8f5f36'/>
  <path d='M71 52 Q86 48 90 34 Q78 40 70 44 Z' fill='#8f5f36'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='20' fill='#7a5230'/>
  <!-- ear tufts -->
  <path d='M35 20 L30 8 L42 17 Z' fill='#8f5f36'/>
  <path d='M65 20 L70 8 L58 17 Z' fill='#8f5f36'/>
  <!-- facial disc -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#e8bf85'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='7' fill='#fff6d9'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='7' fill='#fff6d9'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#2b1f4d'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#2b1f4d'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='32.5' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='32.5' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M50 40 L45 45 L55 45 Z' fill='#ff8c1a'/>
  <!-- smiling cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='43' r='2.5' fill='#ff9e7a'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='43' r='2.5' fill='#ff9e7a'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#8ee6ff'>
    <circle cx='80' cy='20' r='3.2'/>
    <rect x='82' y='9' width='1.8' height='11'/>
    <circle cx='21' cy='16' r='3.2'/>
    <rect x='23' y='5' width='1.8' height='11'/>
  </g>
</svg>
